run_write_top_k_vasp_cli: run the write_top_k_vasp script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a sorted cache
run_vasp_relaxation_inputs: run the script with default flags to write VASP relaxation input files for the best k configs per system
run_vasp_single_point_inputs: run the script with the --sp flag to write VASP single point input files instead of relaxations
generate_paths_list: generate a paths_list.txt file containing all output directories for the top k VASP input sets
write_top_k_cache: write a top_k_cache_sorted_byE.pkl file containing the best k adsorbate-slab configurations per system from the input cache
